title: Alder Lane
style: cinematic horror film still, dramatic moody lighting with the subject clearly visible and centered, foggy small American town, cold blue and amber tones, film grain, 35mm, highly detailed, no text, no watermark
caption:
Part 5. Every door in the Mercer house is open. Except one. 🚪

Original fiction. Part 6 tomorrow night.

#scarystories #horrorstory #creepy #storytime #fyp

scenes.narration: Last time: Jenna learned Ruth Mercer was counting the doors of Harlow Creek. Every one of them was open. Except hers.
scenes.image: a single closed door at the end of a foggy lane at night, all the other doors on the street open and glowing

scenes.narration: The Mercer house sits at the far end of Alder Lane. Boarded windows. Grass to the knees. Decades of nobody.
scenes.image: abandoned two-story farmhouse at night, boarded windows, knee-high grass, fog curling around the porch

scenes.narration: She went at midnight, before she could talk herself out of it. The front door was open. Of course it was.
scenes.image: young woman with a flashlight on a sagging porch, the front door of an old farmhouse wide open into blackness

scenes.narration: Inside, it smelled like cold coffee and wet plaster. The kitchen chairs were still pushed back. Two mugs on the table. Dry brown rings at the bottom.
scenes.image: dusty abandoned farmhouse kitchen, two old mugs on a wooden table, chairs pushed back, flashlight beam

scenes.narration: Every door in the house was open. The closets. The cupboards. The oven. Even the little door under the stairs, propped with a brick.
scenes.image: narrow old hallway with every door standing open, a small door under the staircase propped with a brick

scenes.narration: Someone had been keeping them that way. The hinges were oiled. And through the dust on the floor, a path had been swept. Front door, every room, up the stairs.
scenes.image: a clean swept path through thick dust on old floorboards, leading toward a dark staircase, flashlight beam

scenes.narration: Jenna followed it. At the top, the hallway from Tom's tape. She'd watched it a hundred times. In person, it was smaller. Colder.
scenes.image: dark narrow upstairs hallway of an old farmhouse, peeling wallpaper, cold blue light at the far end

scenes.narration: And at the end of it, one door. The bedroom. The only shut door in the house. Locked from the inside.
scenes.image: close-up of an old bedroom door with a brass deadbolt, a flashlight beam trembling on the lock

scenes.narration: Her watch said 3:11. She told herself she'd leave. Her feet didn't move.
scenes.image: young woman's pale face in a dark hallway, lit from below by a weak flashlight, eyes wide

scenes.narration: At 3:12, someone knocked. Not on the front door. On the bedroom door. From the inside.
scenes.image: an old bedroom door in total darkness, a thin cold light beneath it, dust shaking loose from the frame
